name: Space Trader
description: The Palm OS classic, played in the chat window. Trade between 140 star systems, watch the prices move with tech level, government and whatever crisis a planet is living through, and get jumped by pirates on the way. You make every move; the model reads the position each turn and advises — which good, how many, which system, and what it will cost you if the jump goes badly. It never spends your credits itself.
author: alexbeatnik
